cases.name: stage_print_printer_setting
cases.flow:
mlxflow 0.8
1. Read Text  label.txt
2. Make PDF  page=a4
3. Stage Print  printer=office

issues.message: Row 3's `Stage Print` doesn't take settings -- the file goes to the system's default printer, and v1 has no printer or option settings; remove `printer=`.
